shouldFix.subjectClaim: basedOn.method declares a closed roster, expressly says succession metadata does not authorize unrostered remeasurement-block edits, and lists reMeasurementAtV1, V2, V3, and V5—but not reMeasurementAtV4.
shouldFix.refutation: A recursive JSON diff against the pinned v4 predecessor finds two changes outside the literal roster: /reMeasurementAtV4/note changes from the sole-live v4 statement to a historical-v4 statement, and /reMeasurementAtV4/standing changes from LIVE to HISTORICAL-AT-V4. Conversely, the rostered /reMeasurementAtV3 block does not change in the v4-to-v5 diff. Historicalizing the immediately preceding generation is sensible, but the subject repeats the exact closed-roster failure it claims to repair and expressly denies the only possible succession-metadata excuse.
